To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the generating function of the BPS states of D-branes on a single wrapped D6 brane is given by the square of the partition function of topological string theory on the same Calabi-Yau threefold, and that the BPS spectrum of M2 branes on the same Calabai-Yau threefold is given by a free field Fok space.

(i) The generating function of BPS bound states in the D0-D2-D6 system on a Calabi-Ya 3-fold X, is the square of the generating function of the topological B model on X. (ii) The generating function in (i) is valid in all chambers of moduli space.

(1) the generating function of the bound states of D-branes on a D6 brane is the square of the generating function of BPS states in the M-theory limit, (2) in a chamber where all 4-cycles in X are large, the generating function of D-brane boundstates is the square of topological string partition functions, and (3) in the limit of vanishing complex structure moduli, the generating function becomes the generating function of a free field
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the BPS spectrum of D-branes in type II string theory.
the study of supersymmetric D-brane bound state counting in type IIA string theory compactified on a Calabi-Yaw 3-fold X, which is the mirror of a local Calabi-Yau threefold Y.
the study of BPS states of M-theory and D-branes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the wall crossing formulae for the BPS bound state of D0 and two D2 branes wrapping a D6 brane on a Calabi-Yao threefold X is given in terms of a generating function of BPS bound states, and that this generating function is given as a reduction of a square of the topologial string partition function in terms of the Kahler parameters.
the wall crossing formulae of the topological vertex are a consequence of the existence of M-theory duals.
the topological string is an M-theory dual of the BPS bound state counting on the D-branes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the topological string theory on X is equivalent to the M-theory on X times a 5-torus.
wall crossing in the Fock space is a manifestation of the wall crossing in M-theory.
the topological string theory on a CY 3-fold X is the same as the BPS bound state theory of the D0/D2/D6 branes on X.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for a Calabi-Yaus X with no compact 4-cycle, the BPS spectrum of the D6 brane is organized in a free field Fok space.
the wall crossing phenomena of the D-branes is governed by a simple algebraic structure of the M-theory Fock space.
wall-crossing phenomena for BPS states in string theory can be understood from a geometric perspective, as a change in the topology of the underlying Calabi-Yau space.
